Nordfyns is a Danish municipality referenced in the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK) [^src1]. It is one of the 98 municipalities evaluated for Indicator 5, which measures the prevention of ischemic stroke through anticoagulation treatment in atrial fibrillation patients using data from DanStroke [^src1]. The available data for Nordfyns is limited to a single tabular entry detailing stroke events and patient counts, with no further relationships, specific claims, or historical timeline documented in the provided corpus [^src1].
